fields.q1: All exact collar entries are Gaussian rational; the audited determinants and inverses are rational.
fields.q2: Entries are in Q(zeta8)=Q(i,sqrt2). Real determinant values are converted explicitly to Q(sqrt2).
fields.q4: Entries are in Q(zeta16), whose degree over Q is 8 (not 4). Its maximal real subfield is Q(u), u=2*cos(pi/8)=sqrt(2+sqrt2), of degree 4. Exact cyclotomic forms are retained; no false Q(sqrt2) claim is made.

summary.qsqrt2_obstruction: The nonzero coefficient -54 on u and u^2=2+sqrt(2) would force u in Q(sqrt(2)) if det(A)^-1 were in Q(sqrt(2)). But u=sqrt(2+sqrt(2)) has degree 4 over Q. Thus this dominant q=4 determinant is not in Q(sqrt(2)).
